title: AFRC-2019-13131-1-ArmstrongHighlightVideo-12-2019
description: 2019 was an exciting, successful year at NASA’s Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California. From critical milestones in the development NASA’s first crewed X-planes in 20 years, to unmanned research in support of aeronautics, to breakthrough discoveries in the cosmos through SOFIA, and support of the agency’s efforts to land the first woman and next man on the lunar surface, NASA Armstrong closes out the decade with a year of accomplishment, and excitement for what is to come
keywords: Armstrong, Highlights, X-57, X-59, SOFIA, DC-8, F-18, Research, Aeronautics
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
